description: GENERAL ADMISSION, drafted 2026-09-23 as the rule-book route for what `curated-observatory` admits (handover step 8; evidence analysis/stage2_rules_2026-09/REPORT.md). The curated rule's works that no live rule reaches are overwhelmingly works that state the design in the ABSTRACT, not the title — the live claim tiers are title-only — so this rule carries the abstract arms that measured highest-yield per new work, plus two title shapes the title tiers miss. Six arms: (1) the qualifier family (`direct|conceptual|registered|… replication`) anywhere in title+abstract; (2) `our replication(s)`; (3) `replication attempt(s)`; (4) a SUBTITLE replication (`X: a replication …`, `X. Replicating …`) and (5) `replication of the/a(n) …` in the title, both minus the molecular-biology senses (DNA/viral/genome replication, replication fork/origin/stress, replicon, replicase); (6) `we … replicated` or `replication stud(y|ies)` in title+abstract TOGETHER WITH a reference to an original/previous/prior/published study, finding or result in the same text, minus the same biology senses. Arms 1–3 are carried verbatim from `replication-claim-text` (its arms 5, 7 and 6); the prior-study conjunction on arm 6 is what makes `we replicated` affordable — alone it adds 21,919 works. Measured offline over release c048ab6483d3's inputs with `curated-observatory` shadow: recovers 534 of the 1,345 curated works no other rule reaches (508 of the 1,229 the screen proceeded) and adds ~21.6k works beyond today's 9,105-work pile, 647 of them known replications (Observatory or FLoRA DOIs, 29.9/1k). Precedence 735: inside the claim band, below `replication-claim-title-broad` (740) so a title claim keeps its attribution, above `replication-claim-text` (730), whose arms it partly carries. No vocabulary: admission asks for the screen's attention. LIVE since 2026-09-25 as option B−repo (analysis/recall_options_2026-09/REPORT.md, maintainer decision): the six arms minus data-repository records, which the arms reach because an economics or software-engineering deposit calls itself a "replication package" — two of the eight noes in the hand-check of 20 random proceeds were exactly that. The exclusion is a top-level `none_of` with two arms: (a) a DOI on a data/code registrant — Zenodo 10.5281, figshare 10.6084, Harvard Dataverse 10.7910, ICPSR 10.3886, Mendeley Data 10.17632, ZBW Journal Data Archive 10.15456, Code Ocean 10.24433, Dryad 10.5061 (10.7910 and 10.3886 are already discarded by `deposit-registrant` and are repeated so this rule's own claim does not depend on that one); (b) a title that names the record a replication package/data/files/materials/code anywhere (a Zenodo/OSF deposit is titled `repo: Replication Package` or `Paper title: Replication Materials`, so the phrase is not front-anchored). Unlike `deposit-registrant` this is not a discard: an excluded record simply is not admitted by THIS rule and falls to whatever else matches (usually `pending/no_filter_matched`), so the real preprints Zenodo and figshare also host (2 of the 15 Zenodo works in the sample were proceeds that read as studies) are left unadmitted, not deleted. The measured B−repo definition was Zenodo plus the title arm (19,369 new works on c048); figshare and the other registrants were added at promotion on the maintainer's instruction. `curated-observatory` (745) stays live above this rule, so a curated DOI on an excluded registrant is still admitted by that rule.

measured.sample: analysis/recall_options_2026-09/out/sample.parquet stratum B (seed 20260925): 120 works drawn uniformly from the 21,622 this rule's six arms added beyond release c048ab6483d3's screen_expensive pile, minus the 16 the repository exclusion drops
measured.rationale: The production front-door screen (`classify_replication()`, prompt v3.3, the two shipped voters) run on each sampled work's title+abstract by analysis/recall_options_2026-09/screen_sample.py: 67 of 104 proceed (64%; 74 of 120 = 61.7%, 95% CI 53-70%, before the exclusion). This is the proceed rate the screen will buy, not precision against truth — see the human entry. It is an admission rule: the worst it does is buy a screen call, so this entry records what the promotion buys rather than licensing it (CONVENTIONS.md, 'Promoting a rule out of shadow', fact 4).

measured.sample: analysis/recall_options_2026-09/out/handcheck_B.txt: 20 random screen proceeds from the stratum-B sample above
measured.rationale: One reader: 9 clearly a replication/reproduction, 3 borderline, 8 not (Zenodo 'Replication Package' deposits, supplementary records, CS/ML 'we replicate prior work'). The repository exclusion removes 2 of the 8 noes and none of the clear ones, leaving 9 / 3 / 6 of 18. Rough genuine yield: ~12.4k expected proceeds x ~half clear = ~6k.

measured.sample: every new work over release c048ab6483d3's inputs, counted exactly (analysis/recall_options_2026-09/options.py, with the exclusion applied to its B set)
measured.rationale: Known-replication yield of the new works: their DOIs counted against data/flora.csv (doi_r), the Metascience Observatory database and data/extracted.csv — ~32.9 known per 1,000 new works for B−repo (29.9 for B's 21,622; today's title rules reach the rest). Recall of the curated-only set: the six arms reach ~533 of the 1,345 works only `curated-observatory` admits, which is why that rule stays live.
